titles.kubejs.beginner.flavorText: The start of the journey, where the story begins.
titles.kubejs.chest_opener.flavorText: This is your first Chest Cavity. The second, the third... you'll get addicted sooner or later.
titles.kubejs.mantle_extractor.flavorTex: All things in the world were born to serve me.
titles.kubejs.assembly_line_builder.flav: Craft a thousand tools to probe the dharma; raise ten thousand machines to glimpse the scripture.
titles.kubejs.world_machine_builder.flav: A reaching hand sets stars in the vast; a flick of the finger raises billions of motes of stardust.
titles.kubejs.explore_multiworld.flavorT: Infinite parallel universes. Anything is possible.
titles.kubejs.multiworld_future.flavorTe: Because possibility was witnessed, I see more clearly how small and short-lived I am—luckily, those problems were solved too.
titles.kubejs.ender_dancer.flavorText: You have been above, and above the above, and above that still. You know this stage has no end, and you will devote yourself to the endless final play.
titles.kubejs.my_genesis.flavorText: I study, I remake, I forge, I create worlds!
titles.kubejs.new_tinker.flavorText: I shut the dust-caked door of the old world. I am the strongest craftsman of the new!
titles.kubejs.tinker_study.flavorText: What is the principle of study? What is the heart's answer? What am I?
titles.kubejs.gearsmith.flavorText: A heartbeat like a clock, a twist of pain like teeth.
titles.kubejs.eternal_winter.flavorText: Wind and snow, witness our epic!
titles.kubejs.heart_warm.flavorText: Warm the winter wind with my heart.
titles.kubejs.sun_flower.flavorText: Born under sunlight, warmth feels like a given, never knowing why the sun rises.
titles.kubejs.gate_observer.flavorText: First steps on the path of gateways.
titles.kubejs.gate_conqueror.flavorText: Campaigns this far, and no defeat in sight.
titles.kubejs.gate_smasher.flavorText: Ten thousand gateways, and still none stand above you.
titles.kubejs.gate_buster.flavorText: Now you have mastered the art of breaking them.
titles.kubejs.gate_ruler.flavorText: What I create should sit beneath me.
titles.kubejs.mechanics_scholar.flavorTe: From this time, this place, this instant, I devote myself to the way of machines, and of all things.
titles.kubejs.dim_worm.flavorText: Bore holes through ten thousand worlds.
titles.kubejs.valley_echo.flavorText: A falling stone takes a thousand li before the echo returns.
titles.kubejs.world_wound.flavorText: Cut a rift in the world.
titles.kubejs.rib_blade.flavorText: Ribs for blades, a spine for a sword.
titles.kubejs.forge_hammer.flavorText: The hammer that forges the edge.
titles.kubejs.your_future.flavorText: Those who cannot prove their ability cannot even command the future.
titles.kubejs.sour_pickles.flavorText: My Chest Cavity softens in acid like a cucumber.
titles.kubejs.scapegoat.flavorText: The pain I will not take, you take. The duty I will not bear, you bear.
titles.kubejs.bring_up_me.flavorText: Raise a thousand-mile wall of flesh for just one or two.
titles.kubejs.primal_chestcavity.flavorT: Raise a thousand-mile wall of flesh for just one or two.
titles.kubejs.to_the_future.flavorText: To the future—what I think, what I say, what I do.
titles.kubejs.forever_incense.flavorText: A scent like the one before eternity.
